response.justification: While the candidate is a highly experienced and versatile software engineer with a strong background in full-stack development, they do not meet the mandatory criteria for this specific role. They lack the required 5-10 years of hands-on C++ experience on a Windows platform, have no demonstrated experience with SQL Server or Oracle, and lack the deep capital markets or fixed-income domain expertise necessary for this position.
strengths: Extensive overall software development experience (15+ years) across various stacks and architectures.
Strong background in CI/CD pipelines, DevOps, and test-driven development (TDD).
Prior exposure to the financial tech sector through work at RIDE Capital.
concerns: Lacks the mandatory 5-10 years of C++ development experience, with only 7 months of professional C/C++ experience listed from 2014-2015.
Missing required database experience with SQL Server or Oracle, as well as a lack of focus on the Windows platform.
No proven expertise in Fixed Income, Derivatives, or traditional Investment Banking.
